source_pattern: function with pattern matching over ADT with >3 variants
target_pattern: switch expression over sealed enum with exhaustive checking
transformation: Map OCaml `match` over a variant to a Java `switch` over a sealed interface. Wrap each branch in a method on the variant interface (visitor pattern) or use Java 21+ pattern matching for the `switch`. Preserve exhaustiveness by listing every variant or using a `_ -> throw new IllegalStateException(...)` fallback that the Consumer can later detect and tighten.

examples.source_sdef_excerpt: FunctionSpec { name: "describeExpr", logic: "match e with EInt n -> 'int' | EBool b -> 'bool' | EVar s -> 'var' | ELam _ -> 'lambda' | EApp _ -> 'app'" }
examples.target_code: String describeExpr(Expr e) { return switch (e) { case EInt n -> "int"; case EBool b -> "bool"; case EVar s -> "var"; case ELam l -> "lambda"; case EApp a -> "app"; }; }
